subject: Aukera: Evaluation runbook & ownership (next steps)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@au kerahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aukera: Evaluation runbook & ownership (next steps)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier. As promised, below is a concise post-call recap and a proposed runbook for the evaluation so we can get your team into a hands-on trial next week. I’ve mapped out recommended success criteria, an owner for each track, and a tentative timeline. Please review and flag anything missing.

1) Objective
- Validate Redwood Inference for Aukera’s triage assistant workload (latency under 200ms p95, embedding accuracy within current threshold, and predictable per-token cost).

2) Success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: p95 response < 200ms on 512-token prompts.
- Throughput: sustain 30 concurrent sessions during peak window.
- Cost: projected token cost reduction of >= 30% vs current infra on pilot workload.
- Security: confirm SOC2 controls for logs, KMS integration for customer keys, and VPC peering established.
- App integration: demonstration of end-to-end inference calls to your staging environment.

3) Proposed evaluation plan & timeline (2-week pilot)
- Day 0: Kickoff call + account provisioning (this week).
- Days 1–3: Network setup & SSO test (infrastructure team).
- Days 4–10: Run synthetic load + app integration tests.
- Day 11: Joint review of metrics, iterate on config.
- Day 14: Final review & recommendation.

4) Stakeholder / RACI (who owns what) — high level
- Infra (network, VPC, firewall rules, peering): Ben Carter (Redwood) — R / Jordan Lee (Aukera procurement) for procurement coordination — C
- App integration (staging hooks, SDK integration): Marissa Cole (Redwood) — R / Samantha Green (Aukera) — A
- Security & compliance (KMS, logs, evidence): Laura Bennett (Redwood security) — R / Samantha Green — C
- Procurement / contract steps: Aditya Rao (sales) — A / Jordan Lee (Aukera) — R

5) Next steps (actionable)
- Samantha: confirm your procurement contact (we have Jordan on file; please confirm) and whether Aukera requires an executed NDA before sharing network addresses.
- Jordan / Aukera infra: provide IP allowlist or confirm VPC peering window.
- Redwood: I’ll send the Drive folder with the evaluation matrix + network requirements (attached).

Attachments: Aukera-eval-matrix.xlsx (evaluation matrix), redwood-network-requirements.pdf (network + SSO checklist), POC-success-criteria.md (plain text runbook).

If that looks right, I’ll schedule the kickoff for Mon Aug 24 at 10am PT and send calendar invites.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — this is clear and helpful. A few quick items from our side: 

- Confirmed procurement contact: Jordan Lee is on copy and will be the day-to-day for contracts/PO.
- We do not require a separate NDA for this evaluation but do require an executed DPA before we send any production data. Will that be possible before day 3?
- On security: our security lead (me) will need evidence of SOC2 controls and proof of KMS integration (diagram or short checklist). Can Laura share a short artifact?

We’re good for Mon Aug 24 kickoff at 10am PT. Please include our infra engineer (internal) on the invite — I’ll loop them into Jordan’s reply.

Samantha

Samantha — tagging to confirm procurement + timeline notes. A couple of clarifications from the integration side:

- For the kickoff, please send the infra engineer’s name and their preferred calendar address — I’ll include a short agenda (network + SSO + sample SDK run).

Samantha / team — quick infra notes from my side: 

- Ownership: Redwood infra will own the ephemeral cluster provisioning and monitoring for the trial. We’ll provide the peering config and an allowlist.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration; Laura, I’m looping you for the exact artifact.
- Resource sizing: for the synthetic runs, request 3 gpus with continuous batching enabled — this matches the throughput target. I’ve attached a short sizing note.

Attachments: redwood-sizing-note.pdf

If Aukera prefers a VPC peering window instead of allowlist, we can accommodate — provide your preferred CIDR and a 2-hour maintenance window and we’ll coordinate.

On the procurement side — Jordan, do you need a formal quote or just a PO?

Thanks,
